posts.title: The new mailbox
posts.headline: A bigger mailbox
body: Your mailbox has a new look.
• Rewards: gifts from the team. Tap Claim before they expire.
• News: updates, events and notices from the garden.
A red dot on the mailbox means something new is waiting.

posts.title: Welcome to Bushwack TD!
body: Plant hedges and towers to build a maze. The longer the path the bugs have to walk, the more damage your towers do.

posts.title: Thanks for testing!
body: This is an early build, so some things may change. Thank you for playing and for your feedback.

posts.title: Thanks for testing!
posts.headline: Welcome, Tester!
body: Thank you for helping us test Bushwack TD!
Most tower defense games give you a fixed path. Here, you build the maze: plant hedges to stretch the path, and the longer it gets, the more damage your towers do.
We're a small indie studio, and your feedback shapes the game. Tell us what you love and what feels off.
